_note: Schema level authorization for the records behind admin-only pages (access audit, 18 Oct 2026). Without a block of its own each of these schemas took the register block (91-register-access.json), so every member of dossiq-medewerkers could read and write data breaches, supplier accounts and the tenant records. A schema block replaces the register block for that schema (OpenRegister rbac-scopes, four-level cascade). Supplier accounts and billing events go to admin and beheerders. Tenant memberships and mandates stay readable by staff, because MandateValidationMiddleware reads them as the signed-in user on every request in a tenant, but only admin and beheerders change them. Any member of staff may still report a data breach; reading and handling one is for admin and beheerders, since dossiq has no privacy-officer group. The background service account keeps the access it had wherever a job may read or write these records.
